files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- 🔖 Full support for Nextcloud 33
- 🧨 Drop support for Nextcloud 31 and less (deprecations of Nextcloud Config API, sorry 😥)
- 🌐 Update French translations (by @Jerome-Herbinet)

### Fixed
- 💄 Better progress bar contrast
[#636](https://git.crystalyx.net/Xefir/repod/pulls/636) by @Jerome-Herbinet
- 📱 Fix categories buttons breaking on Nextcloud 33
- 🐛 Do not show trends if there is no trends
